description: This is a C source file implementing a driver for the MAX17048 battery fuel gauge, including functions for reading battery voltage, percentage, current rate, and initialization.

methods.name: max17048_read_register
methods.description: Reads a register value from the MAX17048 device via I2C.

methods.name: max17048_adc
methods.description: Retrieves raw ADC value from the internal ADC.

methods.name: max17048_voltage
methods.description: Calculates and returns the battery voltage in millivolts.

methods.name: max17048_percent
methods.description: Retrieves and converts the battery state of charge percentage.

methods.name: max17048_crate
methods.description: Retrieves and converts the current rate of charge/discharge.

methods.name: max17048_init
methods.description: Initializes and verifies the MAX17048 chip.

methods.name: max17048_get_single_prop_impl
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property from the fuel gauge.

methods.name: max17048_get_prop
methods.description: Retrieves multiple properties from the fuel gauge.
